source: Empirical public-runtime validation against active HCD/governance baseline

required_changes: Initial state must be NOT_EVALUATED; do not render 0/23 as an assessment result before required inputs are complete.
Do not render a risk classification before governed calculation completion.

Remove patient-specific/automated claim “Diagnósticos NANDA Sugeridos / Processando raciocínio clínico...”. Replace with governed static related-content language only where evidence and licensing permit.
Result/export/print actions must remain disabled until CALCULATED and validation gates pass.
acceptance: No clinical score/classification visible before calculation

required_changes: Initial state must be NOT_EVALUATED; hide 0 gotas/min before Calculate.
Clear/reset returns to NOT_EVALUATED rather than a clinically interpretable zero result.
Result/export/print actions only after valid inputs and successful calculation.
acceptance: Invalid/empty inputs cannot create a numeric clinical output

required_changes: Preserve skip links/accessibility shortcuts observed in parsed runtime.
Run browser-level keyboard, focus, error-message, contrast and responsive checks before any HCD/WCAG claim.
acceptance: No claim of full WCAG/HCD conformance without independent evidence
